wrong_setting: The interior reads as a small tram or train compartment with long side-facing benches facing each other, not an old country bus with forward-facing rows of seats seen from the aisle.
notes: Repaint as a bus aisle view with forward-facing seat rows. Crop the young man in the foreground so only the back of his head and one shoulder show, with the backpack on his lap instead of his back. Make the sandals closed-toe and darken his skin to match the sheet.
